gate.portNote: The installed ClawBox app instance holds 4231 and serves the project checkout; the gate ran this branch's own server on 4331 and hashed the served files against this checkout.

nonFatal.webglWarningText: WebGL: INVALID_OPERATION: texParameter: no texture bound to target (engine texture setup)

fixes.what: Console strings are typed as one ordered, non-awaited key batch with a serial fallback for modifier characters.
fixes.measured: `timescale 0` plus `condump q2state-probe` took 87.9 s at 2560x1440 before, 14-15 s after; every echoed command matched the exact string typed (6/6 at 1280x720, 3/3 and 2/3 across 2560 probes).

fixes.what: The diagnostic status-bar gl.readPixels backs off from 1.2 s to 4 s only on drawing buffers at least 1920 px wide when one read costs more than 500 ms.
fixes.measured: 2560x1440: 30 reads in 70 s (~24 s blocked) became 14 reads (~11 s) with reads still succeeding (health 100). 1280x720 unchanged at 1.2 s (46 reads in 70 s, 180-267 ms each), which is the cadence the game-mode checks measure.

fixes.what: Wall-clock no-regression bound uses p95 (within 5%) and the median of adjacent page/game block ratios (within 1.02), not pooled per-mode statistics.
fixes.measured: A 2026-11-02 run read 5.5% slower by pooled median while the adjacent-block median was 1.003, the mean 1.2% better and p95 43% better; the pooled median was a drift artifact of always sampling page first.

fixes.what: The main-thread check is a no-regression bound on the paired task/frame ratio (<= 1.02); the work game mode removes is asserted by the deterministic read-back suspension check.
fixes.measured: The page performed 5 read-backs at 405 ms each while game mode performed 0, yet CDP TaskDuration was identical (304.9 vs 303.6 ms/frame): the read is a GPU sync wait, which TaskDuration does not count.

fixes.what: The blaster reference is measured at the spawn loadout with no weapon switch; invulnerability is set before the long captures; weapons are given after the reference; the firing and crouch checks run before the weapon change; the shotgun switch has a console fallback.
fixes.measured: A 2026-11-02 run measured the reference as v_shotg because the 1 key was lost after `give all` (the tap's focus click cannot acquire pointer lock in this headless page).

fixes.what: Each crosshair pair waits for its own scene brightness (dark 20, bright 60) and recovers the game from its menu while waiting; every pair sets the configured crosshair alpha before the on frame and after the off frame.
fixes.measured: A 2026-11-02 run captured the dark menu panel at luma 9.9 as the bright background (3 checks failed); a later run entered the aim section at alpha 0 and every pair was two crossless pictures (4 checks failed with 0 tinted pixels).

fixes.what: Element.prototype.requestPointerLock is wrapped so the promise Chrome returns cannot become an uncaught page exception; the refusal is recorded in window.quake2PointerLockRefused and the standard pointerlockerror path is unchanged.
fixes.measured: 7 uncaught WrongDocumentError page exceptions became 0 in the verifying run.

fixes.what: ensureGame retries a page-state read that times out instead of aborting the run, and every console attempt is recorded in the report notes.
fixes.measured: The 2026-11-01 durable run aborted at check 194 on a single 60 s Runtime.evaluate timeout.

fixes.what: userdata/baseq2/config.cfg is quarantined for the run and restored on teardown, so persisted cvars cannot override the start-up lines each boot depends on.
fixes.measured: Preserved from the owner's working tree; the verifying run used isolated user state.

limitations: Publication was not performed: app_publish is not available to this run. The parent must publish version 1.0.0 from the branch.
clawbox.json carries no version field (the ClawBox manifest schema shown in the field guide has name/description/kind/port/start); the Store version is passed to app_publish.

The gate ran headless with the SwiftShader software renderer at roughly 1.3-3.3 fps. The 219 checks assert correctness and presentation; the frame-time checks are no-regression bounds, not GPU performance claims.
The verifying run used port 4331 because the installed app instance owns 4231. The gate's own file hash check proves the bytes served on 4331 are this checkout.
72 non-fatal WebGL warnings from the engine's texture setup and optional pak1/pak2 404 probes are recorded in the report and are not failures.
The game-mode and crosshair-aim checks run at 1280x720 by design; the 2560x1440 stage covers boot, lighting, weapon draws, status bar, crosshair presentation and menu parity.
Content is the Quake 2 demo PAKs (baseq2/pak0, pak9, pak10). engine/license.txt is the Id demo EULA; a Store listing must state the demo content and that the full game needs retail PAKs.
